main_body: two wooden crates with metal corner brackets
top_band: light brown and medium brown alternating horizontal plank bands on the larger crate from row 0 to row 8 (smaller crate rows 8-14)
evidence: On the main (left) crate, rows 0-8 form a clearly visible horizontal planked top surface with a lighter front edge at row 7-8. Below it, rows 9-19 form the darker brown front face with a dark overhang shadow at row 9, recessed inner panel, diagonal brace, and corner brackets. The smaller crate on the right follows the same 3/4 construction (top rows 8-14, front face rows 15-22).

style.evidence: The crates use warm brown wood tones with dark brown outlines and grey metal corners (4 wood steps, 2 metal steps), but the surfaces are very geometric and repetitive—uniform 1px alternating horizontal stripes on the top and flat brown fills with a single 1px diagonal line on the front face—lacking the organic wood grain, varied highlight placement, and rich pixel density seen on the Beodeul stall and well references.
